$comment: Flattens surviving descriptors out of membrane.out.Graph and dispatches each VERBATIM as $Item to the colonel chain. The chain's first processor is file-read (processors/file-read.ps1); every processor clones the item (Copy-Bag) and adds. out.bag is therefore membrane.out.file ∪ file-read's additions ∪ whatever else the chain attached — OPEN beyond the fields listed. Colonel's parameter surface is reflected (New-ForwardedParamDictionary), not restated here.

FilteredFsGraph.note: membrane.out.result — @{ Graph; Skipped }; also accepts a bare Dictionary/array of nodes

….note: all Compile-Plan / Invoke-Plan params, forwarded by name

Files.note: the only node field ingest reads; node context is gone after flattening

AbsolutePath.note: read by file-read (the only descriptor field the chain NEEDS)

Results.note: index-stable in eligible order; null slot = worker returned nothing

Skipped.note: membrane.out.skipped merged with any dispatch skips

Content.note: decoded text; absent when ReadError is set; mutators replace it

Encoding.note: 'UTF-8' — an asserted decode policy, not yet a measurement (decisions-ledger #28)

_ChainHalt.note: set by any processor that halts the chain

….note: Attributes, Processing, Operations, … — anything a processor attaches

Path.note: the membrane stage's records are merged verbatim
